items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jimmy Palau? No. Or Jimmy Palau? No. [INTERVIEWEE] I mean, no. Got his name on the end of my tongue.

ctx.x: I can't think of that man's name right now. No, he was way back, way before those fellas.
Jimmy Palau? No. Or Jimmy Palau? No.
I mean, no. Got his name on the end of my tongue.
